name: copy_nonoverlapping
declaration: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rules: `src` must be valid for reads of `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes.
`dst` must be valid for writes of `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes.
`src` must be properly aligned for `T`, even if `count * size_of::<T>()` is zero.
`dst` must be properly aligned for `T`, even if `count * size_of::<T>()` is zero.
The memory region beginning at `src` of size `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes must not overlap the memory region beginning at `dst` of the same size.
